ZAF.note: Integration with other government systems is stated only as a capability the modernised system will have.

facts.fact: The SA-SAMS Project Team, for the Department of Basic Education, is modernising SA-SAMS on UNESCO's OpenEMIS, with requirements completed in 2022-2023, curriculum management under way and a pilot in about 10% of schools planned from September 2024.

ZAF.note: The document says nothing about published open data.
The document gives no school internet figure or curriculum statement.

facts.fact: The Department of Basic Education's governance committees agreed to implement OpenEMIS to modernise SA-SAMS, with a DBE EMIS team to support it.
